judgments.reason: The HBN-EEG preprint by the same authors (Shirazi, Franco, Delorme, Makeig) describes the BIDS/HED-formatted HBN EEG data released across the releases, including Release 9.
judgments.paper_title: HBN-EEG: The FAIR implementation of the Healthy Brain Network (HBN) electroencephalography dataset

judgments.reason: Alexander et al. 2017 describes the overall Healthy Brain Network biobank initiative, which includes this EEG Release 9 dataset, but it is not this release's own data paper.
judgments.paper_title: An open resource for transdiagnostic research in pediatric mental health and learning disorders

judgments.reason: Langer et al. 2017 describes a separate 126-participant EEG/eye-tracking resource (ages 6-44), a precursor to HBN, not the HBN-EEG Release 9 data.
judgments.paper_title: A resource for assessing information processing in the developing brain using EEG and eye tracking
